high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation titled "Exploration vs Exploitation." It appears to be part of an educational or academic lecture, possibly from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), as indicated by the logo at the bottom left corner. Title: "Exploration vs Exploitation" Points on the Slide: A deterministic/greedy policy won't explore all actions. At the beginning, one doesn't know anything about the environment. To find the optimal action, one needs to try all actions. An ε-greedy policy is described
